_comment: Every threshold the collector uses lives here, with a rationale, so the audit can be tuned in one place rather than by editing logic. Detectors have their own thresholds; these govern acquisition only.

user_agent._rationale: Identifies honestly and never impersonates a real crawler. The single control fetch is the only exception and it is disclosed in the snapshot.
user_agent.control_fetch_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36
user_agent._control_rationale: A mainstream browser string used once per page purely to detect user-agent differential blocking. Without it a 403 cannot be distinguished from 'the site blocked this audit'.

budgets._rationale: Sized so a typical site finishes inside the five-minute limit with headroom. crawl_delay_cap_s does not ignore a larger declared delay: the delay is honoured and the sample is reduced instead.

discovery._rationale: Caps bound both runtime and the blast radius of a crawl trap. max_query_params keeps faceted navigation from consuming the sample. crawl_max_fetches gives link discovery its own sub-budget so it cannot exhaust the request cap before a single sampled page is fetched; discovery only needs enough pages to see the link graph.

sampling._rationale: Three pages per template is enough to distinguish a template-wide problem from a one-page anomaly, and is the threshold detectors use before reporting at template reach.

classification._rationale: short_page_text_floor exempts legitimately short pages such as contact and legal notices from answer-position and thin-content judgements.

spa_signals._rationale: Mount points are matched structurally: an element with no text content whose id or tag follows a common framework root convention. The lists are conventions, not a single framework's selectors, and an unlisted convention simply contributes no signal rather than producing a wrong one.

url_normalization._rationale: Only parameters that are known not to change the resource are stripped. Everything else is preserved, because dropping a meaningful parameter would make the audit describe a page the site does not serve.

_agent_rationale: The collector only resolves robots verdicts for these tokens. It attaches no meaning to them. Interpreting a verdict as a defect, an info note, or nothing at all is the access detector's job, using its own role table.
